basis: User-reported monthly costs; vendor invoices, renewal dates, taxes, annual commitments, API usage, and plan entitlements are not yet verified.

allocation_policy.shared_cost_rule: Do not divide shared subscription costs across repositories without usage or deployment evidence.
allocation_policy.retention_rule: Retain a subscription only when it protects a live production dependency or produces an accepted business or delivery outcome at a competitive cost.
allocation_policy.credit_rule: Unused credits are not value. Route work only when the work has a durable output, owner, acceptance test, and cost ceiling.
allocation_policy.consumer_plan_rule: Treat consumer subscriptions as interactive seats, not gateway capacity, unless the provider explicitly permits API or automated use under the plan. Never automate by scraping sessions or sharing credentials.

subscriptions.name: Claude Max
subscriptions.renewal_evidence_required: Accepted high-complexity outputs and time saved that the lower-cost candidates cannot match during a 14-day comparison.
subscriptions.recommended_action: Measure against one primary alternative; downgrade or pause if it does not win a distinct, recurring workstream.

subscriptions.name: Supagrok
subscriptions.renewal_evidence_required: A recurring research task with accepted outputs, sources, and a lower effective cost than alternatives.
subscriptions.recommended_action: Pause at the next reversible renewal unless it wins a named research workload.

subscriptions.name: OpenAI Pro
subscriptions.renewal_evidence_required: Wins the primary interactive-AI seat using accepted outcomes per dollar, not chat volume.
subscriptions.recommended_action: Use as the $100 reference option in the 14-day AI bakeoff; retain only if it wins or owns a non-overlapping task.

subscriptions.name: v0.app
subscriptions.renewal_evidence_required: Accepted, shipped UI work tied to the primary offer and faster than the selected alternative.
subscriptions.recommended_action: Export owned artifacts, run one controlled offer-page task, and retain at most one primary UI generator.

subscriptions.name: Figma full license
subscriptions.renewal_evidence_required: An active customer or product workflow needs editable design files, collaboration, or handoff unavailable on a lower plan.
subscriptions.recommended_action: Keep only if it is the canonical design record; otherwise export assets and downgrade after checking collaborator access.

subscriptions.name: Supabase Pro
subscriptions.renewal_evidence_required: Named projects, owners, backups, security posture, traffic, and a live revenue or internal-foundation dependency.
subscriptions.recommended_action: Inventory projects and map each database to source, deployment, data owner, and recovery requirements before consolidation.

subscriptions.name: RouteReady Supabase micro database
subscriptions.renewal_evidence_required: Matching source repository, live consumer, data owner, backup, and an explicit reason it cannot share the governed Supabase organization.
subscriptions.recommended_action: Treat as a protected unknown until source and data ownership are established; then consolidate, retain, or retire deliberately.

subscriptions.name: GitHub organization team
subscriptions.renewal_evidence_required: Organization ownership, access control, and repository governance remain in use.
subscriptions.recommended_action: Retain while it protects company source and access control; repair connector read scope for complete portfolio evidence.

subscriptions.name: Vercel Pro - Dobeu Tech Solutions
subscriptions.renewal_evidence_required: Every production project maps to a canonical repository, domain, owner, analytics, and revenue or approved demonstration purpose.
subscriptions.recommended_action: Consolidate deployments around dobeucloud and the first offer; remove stale previews only after domain and rollback checks.

subscriptions.name: GitHub Copilot Pro
subscriptions.renewal_evidence_required: Measured editor-specific throughput that remains useful alongside the selected agent environment.
subscriptions.recommended_action: Pause if Ona or the primary AI seat covers the same coding loop without a measurable loss.

subscriptions.name: Google AI
subscriptions.renewal_evidence_required: A Google-specific workflow or a bakeoff win based on accepted outcomes per dollar.
subscriptions.recommended_action: Pause unless a named Google-integrated workload proves unique value.

subscriptions.name: Lovable Business 3
subscriptions.renewal_evidence_required: A currently deployed, owned application requires the plan or it wins the controlled UI build test by a material margin.
subscriptions.recommended_action: Highest-priority builder-plan audit: export source/assets and verify deployed dependencies before downgrading or pausing.

subscriptions.name: Bolt.new
subscriptions.renewal_evidence_required: Wins a named prototype workload and generates portable source with acceptable quality.
subscriptions.recommended_action: Pause unless it wins the same controlled task against the selected builder.

subscriptions.name: Replit
subscriptions.renewal_evidence_required: A live hosted workload or collaboration need that is not better served by Ona plus the canonical deployment platform.
subscriptions.recommended_action: Export projects and pause if no mapped live workload depends on it.

subscriptions.name: Ona Core
subscriptions.renewal_evidence_required: The internal foundation and revenue delivery run reproducibly here with accepted artifacts and lower coordination cost.
subscriptions.recommended_action: Retain through the internal-foundation release and measure completed delivery milestones per month.

prepaid_capacity.name: Make.com operations/credits
prepaid_capacity.evidence: User-supplied screenshot; capture time, billing price, operation accounting, and exact reset date are unverified.
prepaid_capacity.recommended_action: Use the credit sprint for durable portfolio telemetry, approved sales operations, memory ingestion, and failure-tested delivery workflows; do not create activity solely to exhaust credits.

scenario_bookends.note: These are comparison bookends, not cancellation instructions. Live dependencies, commitments, exports, access, and renewals must be checked first.
